title: Sign in and reach the platform dashboard
description: This verifies that an existing user can sign in with valid credentials and access the main platform dashboard.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Verify the platform dashboard is displayed

title: Create a new account
description: This verifies that a new user can create an account with valid registration details and proceed into the onboarding flow.

steps.description: Navigate to /signup
Fill in the full name field with a valid name
Fill in the company email field with a valid company email
Fill in the password field with a valid password
Submit the registration form
Verify the next onboarding step is displayed

title: Block unauthenticated access to organization onboarding
description: This verifies that a user without an active session cannot open the organization onboarding page and is kept out of the protected flow.

steps.description: Navigate to /onboarding/organization
Verify access to the protected onboarding flow is blocked

title: Set up a project and connect a repository
description: This verifies that an authenticated user can create a project, choose GitHub as the provider, select scanner modules, and continue onboarding.

steps.description: Navigate to /onboarding/project
Fill in the project name field with a valid project name
Select GitHub as the repository provider
Select the SAST scanner module
Select the Secrets scanner module
Select the SCA scanner module
Continue the onboarding flow
Verify the platform dashboard is displayed

title: Complete organization onboarding and continue
description: This verifies that an authenticated user can enter organization details and continue to the next onboarding step.

steps.description: Navigate to /onboarding/organization
Fill in the organization name field with a valid organization name
Fill in the organization details field with valid organization details
Continue the onboarding flow
Verify the next onboarding step is displayed

title: Create a project and finish onboarding

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Navigate to /onboarding/project
Fill in the project name field with a unique project name
Select GitHub as the repository provider
Select the SAST scanner module
Select the Secrets scanner module
Select the SCA scanner module
Continue with onboarding
Verify the user lands on the platform dashboard
